card.name: Inside drug names in instructions
card.fires_on: Late parts of a drug name or the word right after it (salt, tablets, for oral suspension) when the label gives an instruction to stop, reduce, increase or prime that drug.

modes.label: Ending of a drug name
modes.description: Final pieces of a long generic drug name or salt, such as -ine, -ide, -il, in a dosing or stop instruction.
modes.example: After one week, increase to fesoterod<<ine>> fumarate extended-release tablets 8

modes.label: Word after the drug name
modes.description: The dosage-form word or linking word that follows a drug name in an instruction.
modes.example: Reduce cilostazol<< tablets>> dose to 50 mg twice daily

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a drug's full name when the label tells you to stop, change or start that drug.
